2020
VERSA®
Nissan Intelligent Mobility guides everything we do. We’re using new technologies to transform cars from
mere driving machines into assistants. Together the journey is more confident, connected, and exciting.
Whether it’s cars that assist in the driving task, or highways that charge your EV as you go along, it’s all
in the very near future. And it’s a future already taking shape in the Nissan you drive today.

model in the lineup. Available on desktop, smartphone, or tablet, it’s the full product
story – including demos, videos, and complete info on trims, colors, and accessories.
